verdict.rationale: Carta documents an official MCP setup (the 'claude-mcp-setup' guides) with pre-built plugins that let an agent query cap tables, SAFEs, option grants, 409As, fund performance, and partner data in natural language. A probe confirms the official MCP server documentation exists. However, the docs are framed around Claude plugins, and the snippets give little on setup mechanics. Missing for 10: details on connection and auth configuration, evidence of support for MCP clients other than Claude, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as documented.
